name: reusefirst
description: ReuseFirst (Reuse-First Builder): finds the closest existing Claude plugins and GitHub open-source projects for a requirement (% closeness, reuse/extend/build verdict), then builds a new app or enhances an existing one with Claude Code to bundled engineering (UAISES) and UI (UEUIS) standards. Web UI at http://127.0.0.1:5057/.
